newsitem.title: USA: Edison Brothers files disclosure statement.
newsitem.headline: Edison Brothers files disclosure statement.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc filed its disclosure statement Monday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.
The disclosure statement provides financial details for the plan of reorganization filed on February 27.
Under the reorganization plan, all of Edison's existing common stock will be canceled and the company will issue 10 million shares of new common stock.
The company's shareholders will receive two sets of warrants that will entitle them to buy up to nine percent of the new common stock.
According to the disclosure statement, Edison will distribute 416,667 3-year warrants and 548,247 6-year warrants.
The exercise price of the 3-year warrants is $13.85 and of the 6-year warrants is $22.10. The estimated recovery by shareholders is $0.18 per share, court papers say.
The plan also provides creditors with a combination of cash, new corporate debt and other assets to settle about $440 million in creditor claims.
The reorganization plan must be approved by both the creditors and the bankruptcy court. Edison Brothers hopes to have the plan confirmed by mid-summer.
Edison Brothers filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on November 3, 1995.
